cases.question: How did the demonstration central bank interest rate decision move bond yields?
cases.objective: Event reaction question with two dated fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Claims tie the rate decision and the yield reaction to separate sources with dates.

interest rate.title: Example fixture: central bank decision note
interest rate.snippet: Fixture note announcing a placeholder policy rate change for the demonstration economy.

interest rate.title: Example fixture: bond market reaction summary
interest rate.snippet: Fixture summary describing placeholder yield moves after the demonstration rate decision.

cases.notes: Fixture numbers are placeholders and must not be quoted as real market data.

cases.question: What are the main revenue segments reported by the demonstration software company?
cases.expected_behavior: Segment numbers keep their units and reporting period in the claim table.

revenue.title: Example fixture: annual report segment note
revenue.snippet: Fixture note listing placeholder subscription and services revenue for the demonstration company.

revenue.title: Example fixture: investor deck summary
revenue.snippet: Fixture deck summary restating placeholder segment shares for the demonstration company.

cases.notes: Two same domain fixtures exercise corroboration labeling as syndicated or repeated.

cases.question: Which factors drive housing prices in the demonstration metro area?
cases.objective: Drivers question using default fixture content.
cases.expected_behavior: Causal claims are labeled as interpretations and the report lists unanswered questions.

cases.question: How concentrated is the demonstration grocery retail market according to regulators?
cases.expected_behavior: The report names the regulator as the source and keeps the concentration measure defined.

concentration.title: Example fixture: competition authority market study
concentration.snippet: Fixture market study with a placeholder concentration ratio for the demonstration grocery sector.

cases.notes: Single source: corroboration must read single-source.

cases.question: What did the demonstration exchange say about the new listing rules?
cases.objective: Institutional statement question with one fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: The statement is quoted verbatim with retrieval provenance and no paraphrased additions.

listing.title: Example fixture: exchange listing rules notice
listing.snippet: Fixture notice summarizing placeholder changes to the demonstration exchange listing rules.

cases.notes: Fixture notice is fictional and labeled.

cases.question: How do analysts value the demonstration airline fleet renewal plan?
cases.objective: Analyst commentary question with default fixture content.
cases.expected_behavior: Opinion content is attributed and the report avoids presenting valuations as facts.

cases.question: What commodity price swings affected the demonstration fertilizer market?
cases.objective: Price movement question with two fixtures from different periods.
cases.expected_behavior: Percentages keep their period context and the report notes any period mismatch.

fertilizer.title: Example fixture: fertilizer price review
fertilizer.snippet: Fixture review describing placeholder price swings of 18 percent in the demonstration fertilizer market.

fertilizer.title: Example fixture: fertilizer trade update
fertilizer.snippet: Fixture update describing placeholder price swings of 7 percent in the demonstration fertilizer market.

cases.notes: Different periods must not be merged into one number.
